div.div:
ping_pong example (tiles 0 ↔ 15)
each turn: WriteUnique to shared line, notify via ChiGem5EventBus; peer wait_on() wakes, reads back. In rnf_l2 the line ping-pongs between leaf caches (SnpUnique); in rni every access crosses to the HN-F.

div.span: Per-tile mode is possible mechanically — CHI_Tile's constructor takes a mode string — but the shipped generator (CHI_Tile.make_generator) passes one mode to every tile, so --rn-mode is currently system-wide. The coloring above illustrates the shape of what a mixed generator would produce.
